description: Pre-registered analysis plan and configuration lock (Epicure replication protocol)

H1.claim: Composition >= Cooc on mean Spearman rho of strata (b) held-out and (c) external (excluding popularity); ordering Cooc < Core < Composition on (a) baked-in and (b) held-out.

H2.claim: Core has the lowest participation ratio and highest mean pairwise cosine and mode coherence.

H3.claim: Composition >= Cooc on regional Cohen's d across cultural scenes.

H4.claim: Curated vocabulary > size-matched raw on artist-disjoint kNN purity lift (lift difference > 0).

H5.claim: LLM dimensions correlate with measured counterparts (Spearman > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0) for >= 70% of dimensions that have a counterpart.

H6.claim: >= 90% of full-precision held-out rho is retained at <= 64 dims (fp16/int8) for Composition.

H7.claim: SLERP target-dominance (precision@10 of pole tag) increases with theta up to 60 deg for >= 80% of poles.

H8.claim: Conclusions on the standard profile match those on the paper profile (subset).

safeguards.artist_leakage: All linear and ridge probes cross-validated strictly grouped by artist_id; all kNN purity evaluations strictly artist-disjoint
safeguards.llm_free_embeddings: 100% Skip-Gram with Negative Sampling; zero LLM calls during embedding training
safeguards.privacy_and_copyright: Zero raw audio or lyrics stored, distributed, or transmitted
